entities.name: Cape Tempest
entities.description: Wooded nation at the eastern tip of North Aerona, habitable thanks to its sea climate and a large river.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane on which Cape Tempest lies.

entities.name: Coraleon
entities.description: Mysterious city of continued festival on the eastern side of Cape Tempest.
